purpose: STTR partner-type classifier seed list -> NEW_MODEL_ORG label (specs/sttr-spinout-linkage/design.md#partner-type-classification)
curation_protocol: O-6 RESOLVED (specs/sttr-spinout-linkage/open-questions.md): no government master list for new-model/focused-research organizations exists, so this is a curated allowlist, not a bulk-download source pick. Seed = Convergent Research's public FRO portfolio, plus known independents explicitly named in the O-6 resolution (Arc Institute, Arcadia Science, Astera Institute, Speculative Technologies). Each entry is date-stamped with a source URL and was verified (organization is real, and is an FRO/new-model research org) at capture time on 2026-08-14. Incomplete by construction: an RI absent from this list is not NEW_MODEL_ORG by default (classifies OTHER_NONPROFIT or UNRESOLVED per the design's precedence rules), and no fuzzy 'new-model-ness' heuristic is used to add entries.

entries.name: Arc Institute
entries.description: Nonprofit research organization (Palo Alto, CA) partnered with Stanford, UC Berkeley, and UCSF; provides multi-year, curiosity-driven funding to scientists outside the traditional grant cycle.
entries.verification_note: Confirmed as a real 501(c)(3)-model nonprofit research organization explicitly built as an alternative institutional model; matches FRO/new-model scoping.

entries.name: Arcadia Science
entries.description: Research and development institute using evolutionary biology as a discovery platform; publishes an open, continuous research model outside traditional academic/nonprofit structures.
entries.verification_note: CAVEAT: multiple independent public sources (Crunchbase, PitchBook, a founder Medium post) describe Arcadia Science as a for-profit institute/incubator, not a 501(c)(3) nonprofit -- unlike every other entry on this list. It is real and is a genuine 'new research model' organization matching the O-6 description, but its for-profit structure is a mismatch with the nonprofit-institution framing used elsewhere in the RI partner-type vocabulary (NONPROFIT_INSTITUTE, OTHER_NONPROFIT). Retained per the explicit O-6 naming (a frozen resolution is not re-litigated here), but flagged for the spec owner: confirm whether a for-profit RI can legally be the STTR non-federal RI partner before this entry is used to award NEW_MODEL_ORG on a live award.

entries.name: Astera Institute
entries.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit that funds, incubates, and sometimes directly runs high-impact fundamental scientific research; hosts pre-spinout projects (e.g. via its residency program) before they become independent nonprofits, for-profits, or public-domain outputs.
entries.verification_note: Confirmed as a real 501(c)(3) nonprofit operating a new-model research/incubation structure; also listed separately in fiscal_sponsors.json for its sponsor/incubator role over other projects (dual role permitted by O-6).

entries.name: Speculative Technologies
entries.description: Nonprofit that runs coordinated, ARPA-model research programs on materials and manufacturing that are too speculative for a startup and too coordination-heavy for a single academic lab; self-describes as a Focused Research Organization.
entries.verification_note: Confirmed as a real nonprofit FRO; matches scoping directly.
